title: OweHub
features:
🌱 Main Tab
Auto Harvest – Automatically harvests all ready crops from your plots.
Auto Plant – Plants seeds automatically on empty plots with saved position support.
WalkSpeed Slider – Adjust your movement speed (16–150). Persistent even after respawn.
JumpPower Slider – Adjust your jump height (50–300). Persistent even after respawn.
🛒 Shop Tab
Auto Buy Seeds – Automatically purchases selected seeds from the Seed Shop.
Auto Buy Gear – Automatically purchases selected gear from the Gear Shop.
Auto Sell – Automatically sells harvested crops. Supports "Sell All" mode and inventory-full trigger.
⭐ Misc Tab
Fake AFK Status – Toggles the AFK title above your character without actually being AFK.
Anti-AFK – Prevents you from being kicked for idling (enabled by default).
